title: IRAN'S DRONES OBLITERATE US BASE IN JORDAN, ARMY VOWS RELENTLESS RETALIATION UNTIL FINAL VICTORY
text:
IRAN'S DRONES OBLITERATE US BASE IN JORDAN, ARMY VOWS RELENTLESS RETALIATION UNTIL FINAL VICTORY"

"Iran's Army has struck the US-controlled Al-Azraq base in Jordan with devastating drone attacks, targeting F-18 fighter jet sites, troop barracks, and a major weapons warehouse in the seventh phase of Operation Lightning."

"The strikes come as direct punishment for Washington's truce violations and "savage aggression" against Iranian territory. The Army declared that the "era of hit-and-run is over," warning that any threat to Iran's land, air, or waters will face crushing, proportionate force. With six phases already completed, Iranian forces have pledged to continue their offensive operations until absolute victory is achieved.
